notes_for_editor: Tower identity is consistent across Tennessee Landforms (HMT004), Forest Lookouts and the record: Hamilton County, Division of Forestry, district 3, tower 14. Elevation 1073 ft (327.1 m) matches the record. The record's NGS register entry (FC 1846) is an NGS datasheet identifier per the Tennessee Landforms legend; the corrections entry proposes replacing it. The Find a Grave cemetery alias is a lead only; no source ties the cemetery to the tower site. The record's photo (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/2771403.png) was not opened or checked for licence. No build year, design or staffing appears in the sources read.
